pages.speaker: npc
lines: Ah, a challenger finally arrives. I was about to take a nap.

pages.speaker: npc
lines: Although I'm the newly appointed Gym Leader of the Kanto region, I was once a leader in Johto. So, this is nothing new to me.

pages.speaker: npc
lines: Lance may be considered the world's dragon master, but I'm a close second!

pages.speaker: npc
lines: Do you still dare to take me on? Fine, let's do this!
input: !q.is_blank(v.advancement) ? q.run_command('/execute at @e[type=marker,tag=' + v.advancement + '_pos,limit=1,sort=nearest] run tp ' + q.player.username() + ' ~ ~ ~ facing entity ' + q.npc.uuid() );
q.run_command('tbcs battle GEN_9_SINGLES ' + q.player.username() + ' vs ' + q.npc.uuid() + ' as rctmod:leader_clair_004a')

pages.speaker: npc
lines: Years of being defeated as a Gym Leader have changed my perspective, although I haven't been humbled like that in a while.

pages.speaker: npc
lines: TM59 contains Dragon Pulse. It's a huge blast of draconicn energy. Teach it to a Dragon-type. Since you're off to the Pokémon League, this may help you.

pages.speaker: npc
lines: This move strikes fear in its foes. You don't want to miss it.
